senses.gloss: (b. h.) pr. n. m. Malachi, the prophet.
units: <cite ref="Megillah 15a:5">Meg. 15ᵃ</cite> <he>מ׳ זה מרדכי</he> M. means Mordecai, <he>ולמה נקרא שמו מ׳ וכ׳</he> and why is he called M. (minister)? Because he was viceroy.
<cite ref="Megillah 15a:5">Ib.</cite> <he>מ׳ שמו</he> the prophet’s real name was M.
<cite ref="Megillah 15a:5">Ib.</cite> <he>בנביאות מ׳</he> in the prophetic book of M.—
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 28:6">Ex. R. s. 28</cite>; a. e.
